text: Try on different roles and identities. Before starting a difficult conversation, imagine yourself in the other person’s place. When starting a new business project, imagine yourself as a brilliant marketer, and in this state explore your project and give yourself feedback. Something similar may happen automatically in your internal dialogues. But begin to consciously use this technique. Imagination is a gym for your mind, where you can safely rehearse new models of behavior and expand the boundaries of your personality.
